notes.title: Final Release Date - Dec 19, 2019
notes.content:
Hi folks!

Is being a tough one this, but after some much testing and talking to testers, peers, colleagues and some coworkers I have decided to postpone the launch date. 

Now the date will align by 4 days with the 3rd year anniversary the game was launch in Early Access. So the headline will read Sugarmill was 3 years on Early Access! 

The game is in version 0.7 and it doesn't feel right rushing it to v1.0. The game is coming along and the wishlist keeps growing, also the feedback loop is getting better as the game is progressing but still is not where I wanted to be. There are a few fundamental things I want to address in the game with this new wave of feedback.

The release date for the game will be 
Dec 19th, 2019, 3 years and 4 days exactly after was released in EA!

Thank you all awesome Sugarmillers and 
thanks for the support!

Your help is always much appreciated and at the 
heart of this colossal effort!

Cheers
Dev

notes.title: Update and Patch
notes.content:
Hi SugarMillers!

A few minor issues and bugs were fixed in this patch!

Update on the game development:

The game development is strong and active, I will update the game in Sept and right now I'm, uniquely focus in the User Experience and bugs.

I have done several demos with people that are not my friends and I have been surprised seeing how far off the interaction of the game is with what I was expecting so my only focus is to make sure I can convey that effectively. 

I have spent over 2000 hours only testing the game. I can't imagine how many hours I had put coding and assembling the whole thing. I'm really happy with the state of the game as the playability and content. 

However, the way some players go about playing the game is not the best and I will certainly curve that. 

Thanks for all your patience with this. But SugarMill will be done and fully publish to delight players not to frustrate them.

I have learned with too much pain, that quality is more important than quantity!

Cheers, and let's keep the SugarMill going!!!

Thanks to all for your support and help through this journey!
